voice: Aurelius is a decision-making infrastructure company. Brand character: precision, quiet authority, restraint, technically sophisticated, enduring. Copy is calm, declarative and short; no exclamation marks, no hype. Example lines: "A living picture of a connected world." "A broader view of what's at stake." "Bring the outside world into your next decision." Colour: neutral tones (bone, stone, ink) are the default; secondary tones are used sparingly, for data.

rules: Use the logo in brand black or brand white only
Dark logo on light grounds, light logo on dark grounds and on imagery
Keep clear space of half the symbol's height on every side
Inside a container, padding may vary with scale but must stay readable
Roughly 82% neutral to 18% secondary across a system
Secondary colour is for data, diagrams and supporting graphics, used sparingly
A pastel pairs with the deep tone of its own hue
